verdict.rationale: Better Stack's own incident-management page claims "robust one-click reporting on your team's performance with a flexible data export" and says catalog metadata enables "more granular reporting." That is a first-party team-performance reporting capability, but its depth is unproven. Nothing in the evidence names the specific metrics the story asks for. Missing for 10: explicit MTTA/MTTR metrics and trend views, incident-load analytics, on-call health or burnout metrics, detailed reporting docs, independent or hands-on corroboration.
